title: Ruth Paine's sister works for the CIA; Paine brings the Oswalds to Dallas

tellings.quote: Turns out her sister works for the CIA.

plain: In 1963 a woman named Ruth Paine brought Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of killing President Kennedy, and his wife Marina Oswald to Dallas, and Paine's sister worked for the CIA, the US spy agency. The researcher Dan Sheehan tells this without naming a source ("Turns out her sister works for the CIA") and traces the story through Virginia, New Orleans and Dallas. If true, it would tie the spy agency to the people around Oswald just before the killing.
